description: Vervoersnetwerken - Wegen - Netwerk (INSPIRE geharmoniseerd) WFS is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PDOK. The WFs Transport Networks - Roads - Network includes the transport network and physical objects connected to road transport. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Transport networks - Roads - Network (INSPIRE harmonised) WFS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vervoersnetwerken, Hoofdwegen (richtlijn omgevingslawaai), Wegen, Objects, Transport network, Knooppunten. The listing shows 1 download or service links in OTHER. The listing shows 2026-01-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
